name: Hu tieu muc
summary: Hủ tiếu mực is Vung Tau’s breakfast noodle bowl: pork-bone and dried-squid broth with squid, shrimp, fish cake, and quail eggs. Squeeze in lime and add bean sprouts and herbs.
origin: Vung Tau, where it is a local breakfast.
taste: Pork bones and dried squid make the broth, with lime, bean sprouts, and herbs beside the bowl.
howToEat: Eat it in the morning, with lime, bean sprouts, and herbs beside the bowl.
seoTitle: Hu tieu muc — squid noodle soup in Vung Tau
